title: When the Songbook Wakes
author: Emrys Thackeray
blurb: Elodie Yarrow, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
